description: Promotes commercial coconut farming, post-harvest copra processing, and rejuvenation of old palm groves across the islands.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on certified coconut seedlings, drip irrigation systems, and post-harvest equipment.
eligibility: Farmers owning land suitable for plantation crops in Andaman and Nicobar Islands
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office / Agriculture Demonstration Farm

scheme_name: High Yielding Programme (HYP) for Island Crops
description: Distributes high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds of paddy, pulses, and vegetables tailored to island tropical climate.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on seed mini-kits and organic plant protection inputs.
eligibility: All active farmers in North, Middle, and South Andaman, and Nicobar district
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Sub-Station / Panchayat Samiti

scheme_name: Development of Minor Irrigation & Water Harvesting Structures
description: Funds construction of individual farm ponds (Pani Jhora), dug wells, and pump sets to retain heavy rainfall for agriculture.
benefits: 50% financial grant for constructing farm ponds and installing water lifting pump sets.
eligibility: Island farmers holding agricultural land holdings
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Agriculture (Soil Conservation)

scheme_name: Organic Spices Development Scheme (Arecanut, Pepper, Clove, Cinnamon)
description: Supports inter-cropping and high-density planting of spices like black pepper, nutmeg, clove, and cinnamon in coconut orchards.
benefits: Subsidized quality spice saplings plus financial grant of ₹20,000 per hectare for multi-tier cropping.
eligibility: Plantation crop farmers in Andaman & Nicobar Islands

scheme_name: Outer Island Area Livelihood & Agri Grant Scheme
description: Special livelihood grant program for remote outer islands (Little Andaman, Nicobar group) to boost sustainable agriculture, cottage industry, and food security.
benefits: Community and individual grants ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 for local farming inputs and equipment.
eligibility: Residents and tribal farmers in remote/outer islands of A&N
application_mode: Offline via Deputy Commissioner / Tehsildar Office

scheme_name: Soil Conservation & Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Supports terracing, contour bunding, and lime treatment for acidic tropical soils.
benefits: Subsidized agricultural lime supply and 100% free soil testing and recommendation cards.
eligibility: Farmers owning soil-degraded or acidic farmland in the UT
application_mode: Offline via Soil Testing Laboratory / Zonal Officer

description: Protects high-value crops and vegetable nurseries from heavy tropical rains using UV-stabilized shade nets and rain shelters.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for erecting poly-houses and rain-shelter structures.
eligibility: Vegetable farmers and nursery operators in A&N Islands
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Agriculture, Port Blair

scheme_name: Island Organic Farm Input & Bio-Pesticide Subsidy
description: Encourages pesticide-free organic farming across the archipelago by subsidizing bio-fertilizers, neem oil, and compost units.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on certified bio-pesticides and organic manure distribution.
eligibility: Farmers practicing organic agriculture in A&N Islands

description: Provides small weeders, brush cutters, paddy transplanters, and coconut climbing devices at subsidized prices.
benefits: 50% to 60% direct subsidy on light farm machinery suitable for hilly/island terrain.
eligibility: Individual farmers and SHGs in A&N Islands
application_mode: Offline via Engineering Wing, Agriculture Department, Port Blair

scheme_name: Promotion of Bee-Keeping (Apiculture) in Plantation Crops
description: Promotes apiculture in coconut and spice gardens to enhance crop pollination and supplement household income.
benefits: 40% subsidy on bee boxes, honey extractors, and bee colony units.
eligibility: Farmers and rural youth in A&N Islands with coconut/horticulture land
